Copy number variant repeat data

data_cnv.Rd

Copy number variant repeat data

Usage

data_cnv

Format

A dataframe in tidy format with columns for sample, replicate, gene and dosage. Dosages for 3 genes are provided for each sample replicate.

Source

Dosage results are randomly generated with R. The code for generating the data is saved in the data-raw folder.

Examples

data_cnv
#>      sample replicate   gene    dosage
#> 1  Sample 1         1  BRCA1 1.9575155
#> 2  Sample 1         2  BRCA1 2.0576610
